newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power up on unit, line outages.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power up on unit, line outages.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. finished flat to higher Thursday on outages of several generating units and expected maintenance shutdown of a major New York-Quebec power line.

"It's a plain lack of generation. A lot of companies are not quoting anything extra," a New York trader, adding some participants were reluctant to sell surplus energy as the start of the winter season approaches.
Ongoing generation and transmission contraints coupled with high fuel costs continued to support unusually strong power prices, market sources said.
